title: 第2787章 男人的小心眼第2786章 入了狼穴
slug: 乾坤至尊诀第2791章政变再变
content_zh:
“快停下，你作甚？”
见那人真想动手，这位四长老忙轻声喝住了他。
“怎么啦？”
“不能动，动不了。你先在处盯着，我回去告诉公子。”
“四叔，如何，是轩辕封这混蛋，还是姓赵的小畜生？”
还没等那中年人走出几步，前方处几个人匆匆赶了过来。且一见那人使急呼呼地问道。
原来这群人正来自无极的，这位年轻人也正是无极殿少主欧阳玉。
十天前，当内线告知轩辕封带人来到武仙城时，他即刻也带着一帮人来到武仙城。
况且，另外他听说赵宇这些日子也在武仙城，还要参加什么丹器两阁的考核。
一听这，欧阳玉内心更是激愤。经这段的打探，也让他确定上次在仙灵皇朝，把他弄大败亏输的，惨不忍睹的就是这小子。
就是这个名不见经传的小人物，赵宇。
那次不但让他狼狈不堪，更让他颜面扫地。
他的巫蛊之术，最后竟用在一条妖畜母狗上，这丢人丢得天下尽知。
这是让人何等不堪？
尽管他至今还不知，这小畜生是如何做到这一点的。
更可恨的是，让他彻底失去了灵蕾。
不知为何，现在的灵蕾，是他过不去的坎，让他深陷其中，无法自拔。
他得了魔症。
或许他才是真正的蛊毒深种的那人。
“四叔，听说这六人中，还有三位女子可对，这三人又是谁？有灵蕾吗？”

见了这位中年人，欧阳玉一句问罢，第二句第三句接踵而来。
而且，那神情之急迫，已经到了急不可待的地步。
“是轩辕封不假，但那三个女子应该是登天阁的人。”
看到欧阳玉那神情，那位中年人淡定地答了一句。
“四叔，你可确定？我听说灵蕾姐妹俩已到了武仙城。”
不知欧阳玉如何知道了灵蕾的行踪，他现在的神态近乎临近崩溃。
因为他已经得知现在灵蕾已经跨出了那一步，两人竟双栖双宿起来。
欧阳玉听到这消息，犹如在心口被人捅了一刀。
“少主，请冷静，你现在不能露面。”
见欧阳玉状态有些疯癫，这位族叔忙劝阻道。
“少主，此次你来武仙城责任重大，还有大事要做。再说现轩辕擎已经出关，重掌登天阁大权，我们必慎之又慎。”
看着欧阳玉又近似疯狂，这位族叔只好又捧又抬，劝说欧阳玉不可鲁莽行事。
“四叔，这世上有所谓两大恨，一谓杀父之仇，二谓奇妻之恨。我堂堂无极殿少主，岂能受此奇耻大辱。”
说到这，这货倒又是那么的振振有词。
“那个少主，这六人已经离开了。”
content_en:
"Stop it, what are you doing?"
Seeing that the man really wanted to take action, the fourth elder quickly stopped him softly.
"What's wrong?"
"You can't move, you can't move. Just keep an eye on everything. I'll go back and tell the young master."
"Fourth uncle, what do you think, is it Xuanyuan Feng, the bastard, or the little beast named Zhao?"
Before the middle-aged man could take a few steps, several people hurried over from the front. When he saw the man, he asked anxiously.
It turns out that this group of people is from Wuji, and this young man is also Ouyang Yu, the young master of Wuji Hall.
Ten days ago, when the insider informed Xuanyuan Feng that he had brought people to Wuxian City, he immediately brought a group of people to Wuxian City.
Moreover, he also heard that Zhao Yu was also in Wuxian City these days, and he had to take part in the assessment of the two alchemy chambers.
Upon hearing this, Ouyang Yu became even more angry. After this period of inquiring, he also confirmed that it was this kid who caused a huge defeat for him in the Fairy Dynasty last time. The one who was miserable was this kid.
It's this little-known little guy, Zhao Yu.
That time not only made him embarrassed, but also disgraced him.
His witchcraft skills were finally used on a demonic bitch, which was a shame known to the whole world.
How unbearable is this?
Although he still doesn't know how this little beast did this.
What's even more hateful is that he completely lost Linglei.
For some reason, the current Ling Lei is a hurdle that he can't get over, making him trapped in it and unable to extricate himself.
He has a demonic disease.
Maybe he is the one who is truly poisonous.
"Fourth uncle, I heard that among these six people, there are still three women who can be matched. Who are these three people? Is there any Linglei?"
After meeting this middle-aged man, Ouyang Yu asked a question, and the second and third questions followed one after another.
Moreover, the look on his face was so urgent that he couldn't wait any longer.
"It's true that it's Xuanyuan Feng, but those three women should be the people of Dentian Pavilion."
Seeing Ouyang Yu's expression, the middle-aged man answered calmly.
"Fourth Uncle, are you sure? I heard that the Linglei sisters have arrived in Wuxian City."
I don’t know how Ouyang Yu knew Linglei’s whereabouts, but his current demeanor is almost on the verge of collapse.
Because he already knew that Lingyue had taken that step, and the two of them were living together.
When Ouyang Yu heard the news, he felt like he had been stabbed in the heart.
"Young Master, please calm down, you can't show your face now."
Seeing that Ouyang Yu was in a crazy state, the clan uncle hurriedly tried to dissuade him.
"Young Master, you have a heavy responsibility when you come to Wuxian City this time, and you still have big things to do. Besides, now that Xuanyuan Qing has been released from seclusion and has regained the power of Dengtian Pavilion, we must be cautious."
Seeing that Ouyang Yu was almost crazy, the uncle had no choice but to praise and persuade Ouyang Yu not to act recklessly.
"Fourth uncle, there are so-called two great hatreds in this world. One is the hatred of killing one's father, and the other is the hatred of one's strange wife. How can I, the majestic young master of Wuji Palace, suffer such a great shame and humiliation?"
Speaking of which, this guy is so plausible.
"That young master, these six people have already left."
